figures.caption: Fig. 5. Recall@10 plotted against planted-spike width w at planted cosine α = 0.45. Per expectation, the mean-pool baseline tracks w/N — climbing from chance at w = 1 to perfect recall by w ≈ 30. Spectral retrieval already hits perfect recall at w = 3. The two methods converge to identical recall as w → N (when the spike fills the entire document).

Fig. 3. Synthetic-benchmark Recall@10 plotted against the planted-spike cosine α = v · q. Mean-pool recall sits at chance for every α (Recall@10 ≈ 0.02): the spike’s contribution to the document mean is only O(1/N) before normalisation, and it remains buried among distractor means in this finitecorpus regime. Spectral recall, by contrast, shows a sharp transition near α ≈ 0.5 and hits Recall@10 = 1.0 at α = 0.60. The transition tracks the corpuslevel top-k token threshold, roughly √ 2 log(MN/k)/d for Recall@k.
